questions.question_text: Read the unseen passage segment about a young boy finding a stray puppy. According to the text, where did the boy first notice the shivering puppy?
options: B) Hiding under a parked car near the bakery
C) Playing in the central town park
D) Swimming in the village pond
questions.answer: B) Hiding under a parked car near the bakery

questions.question_text: Based on the passage, what did the boy use to dry the wet puppy before bringing it inside?
options: B) His own woolen school sweater
questions.answer: B) His own woolen school sweater

questions.question_text: Find a word from the passage which means the exact opposite of 'cruel'.
questions.answer: C) Compassionate

questions.question_text: Why did the boy hesitate before taking the stray puppy to his home? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: He hesitated because he knew his mother usually disliked having animals inside the house, and he was afraid she might get angry and ask him to leave the puppy outside in the cold.

questions.question_text: How did the mother's reaction surprise the boy when he finally presented the puppy? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Instead of getting angry, the mother immediately felt pity for the helpless creature. She smiled, quickly brought a bowl of warm milk, and helped create a cozy bed using an old blanket.

questions.question_text: What moral lesson does the passage convey about kindness toward animals? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The passage teaches that showing kindness to helpless animals brings unexpected joy. Even small acts of compassion can completely change a creature's life and soften the hearts of people around them.

sections.section_name: Section B - Writing Skills & Applied Grammar

questions.question_text: Identify the subject in the following sentence: 'The large brown dog barked loudly at the stranger.'
questions.answer: C) The large brown dog

questions.question_text: Choose the correct abstract noun to complete the sentence: 'The king was known throughout the land for his immense __________.'
questions.answer: B) wisdom

questions.question_text: Select the correct pronoun for the blank: 'Ravi and Amit forgot to bring _____ English textbooks to class.'
questions.answer: C) their

questions.question_text: Choose the correct comparative degree adjective: 'This puzzle is much __________ than the one we solved yesterday.'
questions.answer: C) more difficult

questions.question_text: Fill in the correct article: 'She wants to become ___ astronaut when she grows up.'
questions.answer: B) an

questions.question_text: Identify the tense of the given sentence: 'The children will be playing in the garden tomorrow.'
questions.answer: C) Future Continuous Tense

questions.question_text: Select the appropriate modal verb: 'You __________ wear a helmet while riding a bicycle for your own safety.'
questions.answer: C) must

questions.question_text: Identify the type of sentence: 'What a beautiful painting you have created!'
questions.answer: D) Exclamatory

questions.question_text: Write a short paragraph describing your favorite hobby and how it makes you feel. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: My favorite hobby is reading adventure books. Whenever I open a new book, I feel like I am traveling to magical lands and meeting brave heroes. Reading helps me relax after a long day at school and vastly improves my vocabulary. It is a wonderful escape that constantly sparks my imagination and creativity.

questions.question_text: Write a formal application to your school principal requesting two days of sick leave due to a high fever. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: To The Principal, XYZ School, City. Respected Madam/Sir, I respectfully state that I am suffering from a high viral fever. The doctor has strictly advised me to take complete bed rest for two days. Therefore, I kindly request you to grant me leave for the 10th and 11th of October. Thanking you, Yours obediently, Amit Sharma, Class VI.

questions.question_text: Read the extract from 'The Raven and the Fox': 'How handsome you are! If your voice is as sweet as your looks...' What was the Fox's real intention behind these flattering words?
options: A) He wanted to marry the Raven
B) He genuinely loved the Raven's singing
C) He wanted to trick the Raven into dropping the piece of cheese
D) He wanted to invite the Raven to a party
questions.answer: C) He wanted to trick the Raven into dropping the piece of cheese

questions.question_text: Read the extract from 'What a Bird Thought': 'I lived first in a little house, and lived there very well.' What is the 'little house' the bird is referring to?
options: B) A pale blue egg shell
questions.answer: B) A pale blue egg shell

questions.question_text: In the story 'The Unlikely Best Friends', how did the two entirely different animals prove that true friendship looks past physical differences? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The fierce lion and the tiny mouse proved their friendship when the mouse bravely chewed through the hunter's thick net to free the trapped lion. This act showed that loyalty and courage matter far more than size or strength.

questions.question_text: What important environmental lesson does the grandfather teach the children about the old tree in 'Neem Baba'? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Grandfather teaches them that the Neem tree is a living pharmacy. It purifies the surrounding air, provides cooling shade, and its leaves possess powerful medicinal properties that naturally heal many common skin diseases.

questions.question_text: In the poem 'A Friend's Prayer', what specific qualities does the speaker ask God to grant them so they can be a better companion? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The speaker earnestly prays for a listening ear, a kind and understanding heart, and the patience to support their friends unconditionally during difficult times, proving themselves to be a reliable and trustworthy companion.

questions.question_text: Why did the young boy in 'The Chair' feel a deep emotional connection to his grandfather's old rocking chair? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The boy felt connected because the chair held countless precious memories. Sitting in it reminded him of the warm evenings spent listening to his grandfather's fascinating stories, making him feel secure and deeply loved.

questions.question_text: In the story 'A Bottle of Dew', Ramnath spends years attempting to collect magic dew instead of working. Describe his journey from a lazy dreamer to a wealthy, hardworking farmer. What was the sage's clever trick? [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Ramnath wanted to become rich using a magic potion made of winter dew. The sage cleverly told him to collect dew exclusively from banana leaves he planted himself. Over the years, Ramnath worked tirelessly, planting and tending hundreds of banana trees. When he finally brought the dew, the sage showed him the immense wealth he had earned by selling the bananas. The trick made him realize that hard work, not magic, is the true source of prosperity.

questions.question_text: Based on the story 'Rama to the Rescue', analyze how Rama's quick thinking and intelligence helped him solve a complex problem that stumped everyone else in the kingdom. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: When the kingdom faced a tricky dilemma regarding the seemingly identical golden statues, all the wise ministers were baffled. Rama cleverly used a thin wire, inserting it into the ears of the statues to observe where it exited. This simple yet brilliant test revealed the subtle internal differences between the statues, proving his superior practical intelligence and earning the king's utmost respect.
